$comment: Slots of sections/hero.ts (staging v5/sections/hero-stage/NOTES.md has the slot table, measured at the budget maximum). H1 = h1a + h1b (Hedvig 72px two-tone: one line each at 1440; 42px at 390: two lines each). Lead = '{lead.pre} [harness 1] [harness 2] [harness 3] {lead.or} [harness 4] {lead.post}', the harness names drawn as keycaps (no glyph), Inter 20px balanced in 760px: two lines at 1440, breaking after [Claude Agent SDK]; 17px at 390: three to four lines. primary: the lime CTA; secondary: the ink CTA (one row at 1440; at the budget maximum they stack at 390). Words: H1 + lead + CTAs stay within 24 so the first screen (with the plate's first step tag) keeps <= 25 marketing words. X placeholders of realistic length (the v4d H1 and CTA lengths); the content phase writes the words. Budgets: tests/home-copy-slots.test.mjs.

$temporary.harnesses: Product names as the task's lead format writes them (README L9: OpenAI Codex, Claude Agent SDK, OpenCode, Pi); not translated.
$temporary.lead.or: The joiner of the task's lead format ('... [OpenCode] or [Pi] ...'); zh / ja joiners are guesses for the content phase.
